notes.title: Road to Early Access #5: NPCs [Video]
notes.content:
Howdy folks!  

We’re back with another peek into the world of Western Rye. In this devlog, we’re showcasing some of the NPCs that help bring our frontier to life.

From settlers searching for hope to mourners at fresh graves, these brief moments offer a glimpse into the atmosphere we’re building, a world shaped by hardship, survival, and stories waiting to be discovered.

This is all work in progress, but every detail brings us one step closer to delivering a frontier unlike any you’ve experienced before.
[hr][/hr]
Ride safe. The West ain’t what it used to be.
- Nixalon Studios
